evidence.text: The dictionary defines 訁 as the written form of the Kangxi radical 言 used on the left side of a character. This supports 言 → 訁 as a positional full-form relationship; it does not identify 訁 as the simplified form of 言.
evidence.title: 訁,言字邊 - Cantonese Dictionary

evidence.text: Unicode describes 讠 as a simplified form of the radical 言 and defines kSimplifiedVariant and kTraditionalVariant as mappings for simplified and traditional Chinese variants. Together with the inspected 谢 entry, this supports the distinct entry-level simplification 謝 → 谢, with 訁 rendered as 讠. It does not change the classification of the literal 訁/言 component pair.
evidence.record_character: 言; 訁; 讠; 謝; 谢
evidence.title: UAX #38: Unicode Han Database (Unihan)

evidence.text: The description identifies this vector as 言 in Shuowen seal-script style and links the supporting source data to Hanziyuan. The page supplies the exact original image link and states that the depiction is public domain. This is a modern vector rendering of a seal-script form, not an ancient artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:言-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: The page describes a Lesser Seal Chinese representation of a Shuowen Jiezi radical, created as modern vector artwork in 2013, manually straightened, and licensed CC BY-SA 3.0. It does not identify the depicted radical as 言, so it is not selected for this entry.
evidence.kind: modern vector image description and rights

search_audit.query: 訁 言 左旁 字形 關係 訁字邊 字典; 谢 simplified from 謝 訁 讠 Unicode Unihan
search_audit.outcome: Opened the Cantonese Dictionary 訁 entry, Unicode UAX #38, and a 谢 entry identifying 谢 as simplified from 謝 with 訁 → 讠. The dictionary explicitly supports 言 → 訁 as a left-position form. UAX #38 independently identifies 讠 as a simplified form of 言.

search_audit.query: Exact Commons pages for local leads 言-seal.svg and Shuowen Seal Radical 056.svg
search_audit.outcome: Inspected both file description pages, their descriptions and licensing, and the exact original-image links. 言-seal.svg is identified as 言 in Shuowen seal style and public domain; radical 056 lacks an identity match to 言 and is CC BY-SA 3.0, so only the first is selected.

search_audit.query: Official Unicode Unihan character records: U+8A01, U+5C04, U+8B1D, U+8C22
search_audit.outcome: Attempted to open all four official character-specific pages; each returned an internal error in the web tool. The harness-provided local kMandarin rows were checked and recorded as local evidence, not as inspected upstream records.

gaps: Official character-specific Unihan pages for 訁, 射, 謝 and 谢 could not be opened in this pass. The supplied local rows give yán, shè, xiè and xiè respectively; these are not claimed as externally inspected page contents.

The verified 言-seal.svg illustration depicts 言, a relevant semantic component, rather than 謝 itself. It is a modern vector rendering of a seal-script form, not an ancient artifact image; no verified reusable historical glyph image of 謝 was established here.
The local Baxter–Sagart readings supplied with the packet were inspected but have no verified upstream table page in this pass; no new external Baxter–Sagart claim is made.
